source_name: Census of India 2001/2011 housing and living-standard tables
notes: Extended diagnostics use 2001 H-04 Appendix/H-05/H-08/H-09/H-10/H-11/H-12/H-13 and 2011 HL-04/HL-06/HL-07/HL-08/HL-09/HL-10/HL-11/HL-12/HL-13 for room/crowding, drinking-water, lighting/electricity, bathroom, latrine type, drainage, separate-kitchen, cooking-fuel, banking, and common asset measures. HL-04 ownership is follow-up-only; richer water, sanitation, and fuel categories are collapsed only where 2001 has an explicit conceptual counterpart. HL-13 and Census-2001 H-04 Appendix supply longitudinal structural-durability shares. Census-2001 H-04 Appendix (PC01_H04a) is active as H04A after all 35 raw workbooks passed structural accounting and exactly matched the 593-district H09 household universe. H04A and HL13 now provide descriptive longitudinal durability changes; durability is not fabricated from H-03 materials and does not expand the fixed housing weak-IV registry.
